exceptions.reason: Two different things share the name: on a board .dl-dialog is the drawn dialog card, in the flow and as wide as its frame; in the app it is the modal <dialog>, placed by the browser with a 24 px gutter (calc(100% - 48px)). The card's own styles come from the design system; the placement stays in the app until the owner renames one of them.

excludedClasses.reason: Two different things share the name: on boards it is the drawn before-and-after layout (a grid of two frames); in the app it is the interactive comparison slider (app/components/ui/v2/design-compare.css). The app keeps its own until the owner renames one of them.
